Class GroupStructure

java.lang.Object
org.roux.token.GroupStructure
All Implemented Interfaces:
StructuralModifier
public final class GroupStructure extends Object implements StructuralModifier
The GroupStructure joins several prompts into one turn. Each prompt has its own list of StateModifier values. A prompt stays only when that list keeps the user half. Kept prompts are joined with a newline. An empty kept prompt adds no characters. The reply stays only when the merge modifiers keep the assistant half. No kept half returns an empty list. // @aa-sdd GK-1061 aetheris-plan-f-174.001.md FINESSE:f-174

  • Constructor Details

    • GroupStructure

      public GroupStructure(List<String> prompts, List<List<StateModifier>> chains, String reply, List<StateModifier> mergeChain)
      The constructor stores the prompts, the modifier lists, the reply, and the merge modifiers. A null reply is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      prompts - The prompts are the member texts, in the order they should join.
      chains - The chains are one modifier list per prompt, in that same order.
      reply - The reply is the assistant half.
      mergeChain - The merge chain is the modifier list for the reply.

  • Method Details

    • turns

      public List<Transcript.Turn> turns()
      The method returns one turn, or an empty list when no half stays. A kept user half stays even when every kept prompt text is empty. A missing modifier list is treated as an ExcludedModifier. That missing list drops the prompt.
      Specified by:
      turns in interface StructuralModifier
      Returns:
      The list contains one turn, or it is empty.

    • chainAt

      private StateChain chainAt(int index)
      The method builds the chain for one prompt. A missing list becomes a chain that holds an ExcludedModifier.
      Parameters:
      index - The index is the prompt position.
      Returns:
      The chain is the modifiers for that prompt.
